Tutorial notes for servicing Shimano rear cup and cone hubs from https://youtube.example.com/watch?v=hub_service_101:
Required tools: 13mm and 15mm cone wrenches, 17mm box wrench, waterproof marine grease. Rear hub requires 9 loose ball bearings of 1/4 inch diameter per side (18 total). Torque locknut to 35-40 Nm while holding the cone in place.
